title: Synth
description: A small subtractive synth: oscillator, ADSR envelope, optional detune and a low-pass filter. Compact notes support per-note pan, fine pitch, release, cutoff and slide without a second attack.

parameters.name: wave
parameters.doc: The shape of the oscillator. noise is a chip-style noise channel: a shift register clocked by the pitch of the note, so a high note is a bright hiss (hats) and a low note a dull rumble (kicks, explosions).

parameters.name: decay
parameters.doc: Time to fall to the sustain level.

parameters.name: sustain
parameters.doc: Level held while the note lasts, in percent.

parameters.name: release
parameters.doc: Time to fade out after the note ends.

parameters.name: detune
parameters.doc: A second oscillator detuned by this many cents (0 is off).

parameters.name: cutoff
parameters.doc: Low-pass filter: sound above this frequency is cut.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
